data.one_liner: Drag and Drop for Dart web apps with mouse and touch support.
data.what_it_does: Provides Draggable and Dropzone classes to enable drag-and-drop interactions in Dart web applications. Supports mouse and touch input, custom drag avatars, and shadow DOM event retargeting.
use_when: You are building a Dart web application that needs drag-and-drop capabilities.
You need touch support alongside mouse dragging for mobile web browsers.
avoid_when: You are building a mobile or desktop Flutter app (this package is for Dart web apps using HTML elements).
You are looking for standard Flutter widget tree drag-and-drop utilities (like Draggable in Flutter SDK).
strengths: Supports both mouse and touch interactions.
Configurable avatar handlers for visual drag feedback.
Support for Shadow DOM and Web Components via retargeting.
weaknesses: Limited strictly to Dart web applications using HTML elements.
Not applicable to native Flutter mobile/desktop apps.
data.setup_notes: Instantiate Draggable and Dropzone classes passing HTML elements or query selectors.
data.minimal_example:
Draggable draggable = Draggable(querySelectorAll('.draggable'), avatarHandler: AvatarHandler.clone());
Dropzone dropzone = Dropzone(querySelector('.dropzone'));
